domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite unlike fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD, LCM, or other common denominator for unlike denominators.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions so the denominators match before subtraction.
Tag in mixed-number problems when only the fractional parts require denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no equivalent-fraction conversion is performed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as n + 0/d unless the step's main purpose is denominator alignment.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that convert 1 whole into d/d after subtraction has begun.

skills.name: Normalize subtraction form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or a mixed number with an improper fractional part into an equivalent subtraction-ready form with standard whole and fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a chosen denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is converted to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when the rewrite is done to enable part-by-part subtraction of whole and fractional components.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary equivalent-fraction conversion whose purpose is only to create a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part during subtraction.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fractional parts into the answer.

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts once they share a denominator by subtracting numerators over the common denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator in a pure-fraction problem.
Tag when fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted after denominators are already the same or have been made the same.
Tag whether the fractional result is positive, zero, or initially negative before any later borrowing step.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the step of finding or creating the common denominator itself.
Do not tag subtraction of whole-number parts by itself.
Do not tag the regrouping action of converting 1 whole into fractional units.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components when solving mixed-number or whole-number subtraction in decomposed form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly computes the difference of whole parts such as 4 − 3 or 3 − 2.
Tag when a whole-number minuend or subtrahend is handled as the whole-part component of a mixed-number subtraction.
Tag even if the resulting whole-part difference is later adjusted because of borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure-fraction items with no whole-part computation.
Do not tag the later borrowing adjustment itself.
Do not tag final combination steps that merely state the completed mixed number or integer.

skills.name: Borrow across mixed number
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as a full denominator-sized fraction when the minuend’s fractional part is too small to subtract the subtrahend’s fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part after an insufficient or negative fractional difference.
Tag when the borrowed whole is converted to d/d or an equivalent full-denominator fraction and added to the minuend's fractional part.
Tag when the whole-part result is reduced by 1 and the fractional subtraction is recomputed.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag if no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number before subtraction begins.
Do not tag ordinary same-denominator fraction subtraction that does not involve converting a whole into fractional units.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the result to lowest terms and express the final answer in an appropriate form such as a fraction, mixed number, integer, or 0.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced to lowest terms.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when whole and fractional parts are combined into the final accepted form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag intermediate subtraction steps that have not yet simplified or finalized the result.
Do not tag denominator alignment, normalization, or borrowing steps.
Do not tag whole-part or fraction-part subtraction by itself.
